notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Budoka Gardener.
Budoka Gardener does not have summoning sickness.
You control eight or less lands.
description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger from step 2, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Repeat.
